title: Tickets read as documents: description, to-dos and blueprint sections in every view
description: A ticket had a title, a why and acceptance criteria, but the web view showed only the description, which was empty. Blueprints now expect a description, to-dos exist as a field, and plantool ticket show and the ticket page present the ticket in blueprint order, naming what is missing. To-dos and acceptance criteria can be ticked in the web view. Outside the happy path: kinds without a blueprint show their description and filled fields only; a failed save unticks the box and reports the error.
why: The owner could not tell from the web view what the open tickets were about.

acceptance.text: Blueprints expect a description for task, feature and bug
To-dos can be set, added and ticked from the CLI
plantool ticket show prints the sections in blueprint order
The ticket page shows the sections and saves ticks
Open tickets of this repository have descriptions

outcome.summary: Blueprint sections in CLI and web view; todos field; open tickets rewritten.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test: 75 pass, 1 skipped; ticket page opened in headless Chromium on Linux, sections rendered and a tick was saved
